about_the_game:
Drink Factory Simulator is a fun and detailed simulation game where you build your own beverage factory from the ground up and grow it into a massive production facility. Starting with a small mixer and a limited set of recipes, your goal is to discover the right ingredient combinations, improve your production lines, and fulfill customer orders to expand your business.

🍹 Develop Your Own Recipes

Create unique beverages like soda, cola, energy drinks, and more using dozens of ingredients and ratio combinations. Finding the perfect mix won’t be easy—but the better your drink, the higher your score and the larger your orders will be.

🏭 Expand Your Factory

Use the money you earn to purchase new machines, unlock production upgrades, and increase your drink variety. What begins as a small manual setup can grow into a fully automated beverage empire.

📦 Manage Customer Orders

Fulfill customer demands accurately and on time. Each order comes with its own requirements, and meeting them consistently boosts customer satisfaction and opens the door to high-value orders.

🔬 Recipe Analysis & Experimentation

Each drink has a secret formula. Wrong ingredient ratios mean lower scores, but the analysis feature lets you test your recipes and identify correct and incorrect ingredients. Experiment to find the perfect formula.

💼 Build, Manage, Dominate

From managing ingredients to expanding your factory and discovering new recipes, you’re in charge. Are you a clever manager or a master mixologist?

Drink Factory Simulator offers a dynamic production experience that challenges both your strategy and creativity. Build your factory, develop your drinks, and dominate the beverage industry!

Ready to mix? 🧃

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700k or AMD Ryzen 3 1200X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 4GB or higher
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
